book_title: Chapter 5: The Six Gauges on the Dashboard & Management's Scorecard
question: Which six operational KPIs tell us whether IGIL's compounding engine is accelerating or stalling, and has CEO Tehmasp Printer's team delivered on its promises?

epigraph.quote: Watch the number of stones crossing the microscope and the days it takes to collect the check; those two numbers tell the whole story before the P&L does.
epigraph.author: Service Tollbooth Rule

web_blocks.title: Six leading operational KPIs to track every quarter

web_blocks.html: IGIL's income statement reflects physical throughput, product mix, and credit discipline. Instead of relying solely on headline profit, an owner should track six leading operational KPIs across quarterly filings and presentations.

web_blocks.takeaway: Five of six operational KPIs are in strong expansion, while debtor days (66 days in FY26) remain the primary operational watchpoint despite Q2 FY27's ₹662M receivables release.

web_blocks.title: Q2 FY27 CONCALL RECORD: VERBATIM CEO & CFO QUOTES (OCT 21, 2026)
paragraphs: Tehmasp Printer (MD & CEO): “This has been the best quarter in IGI's history. Our volumes, our revenue, our EBITDA, and our profits were all the highest we have ever reported.” On brand moat and technology: “It is the IGI certificate that makes the lab-grown diamond a diamond, and it is the same certificate that also protects the value of a natural diamond,” adding that “AI-based work allocation and scheduling is now in use at our laboratories, allowing the same team to grade more stones efficiently.” [4][5]

Eashwar Iyer (Global CFO): “Given the first half performance... with revenues growing 27% and EBITDA growing at 34%... we therefore expect to keep outperforming for the full year as well.” On durability: “There is an element of a first-mover advantage, which IGI has. We were the first to certify lab-grown diamonds. Number two is the fact that there is an element of trust and acceptance for a brand. That has got established over 50 years.” [4][5]

web_blocks.html: The Q2 FY27 numbers show why volume and realization must be read together. Total reports rose 26% YoY to 4.35 million, while operating revenue grew faster at 31% YoY to ₹398.0 Cr [4]. That five-point positive spread proves blended realizations held firm near ₹891 per certification report [4]. Larger-carat LGD solitaires and higher-value studded jewelry offset wholesale stone price deflation. Meanwhile, operating EBITDA margin climbed 340 bps YoY to 61.4% as fixed lab overhead spread across higher throughput [4].

web_blocks.title: Structural potential and management walk-the-talk audit

web_blocks.html: IGIL's structural runway rests on three under-penetrated levers. First, certification attachment rates are rising in studded jewelry, where uncertified local retail still dominates in India. Second, AGL's colored gemstone origin reports can expand globally through IGI's 36-lab network. Third, US and Indian bridal buyers continue shifting toward larger-carat lab-grown diamonds. Management—led by MD and CEO Tehmasp Printer (who founded IGI India in 1999) and Global CFO Eashwar Iyer—has built a credible post-IPO execution record.

In the 2024 IPO prospectus, management pledged to fold IGI Belgium and IGI Netherlands into IGIL right after listing and hold ~57%–60% operating margins while scaling LGD volume. Both commitments closed on schedule in December 2024 [7]. In 15M FY26, IGIL delivered 61% OPM across 16.45 million reports [6]. Entering FY27, management initially guided for ~15% revenue growth. After strong H1 FY27 execution (+23% YoY in Q1 and +31% YoY in Q2), they raised full-year FY27 revenue guidance to 27%+ [4]. The only blemish on the scorecard is the gradual rise in debtor days from 47 to 66 days over three years [1], which demands continued collection discipline.

web_blocks.text: CEO Walk-the-Talk Scorecard: Guidance vs. Execution

web_blocks.html: Under CEO Tehmasp Printer, management has built a track record of under-promising and over-delivering since the December 2024 listing [4][5]. Entering FY27 amid natural-diamond softness, management guided conservatively for ~15% revenue growth. Actual H1 FY27 execution beat that mark, led by Q2 FY27 revenue growth of +31% YoY and 4.35 million reports (+26% YoY). Management then raised full-year FY27 revenue growth guidance to 27%+ while holding ~58%–60% EBITDA margin discipline [4][5].

Working-capital discipline is the one operational KPI requiring ongoing vigilance. Debtor days rose from 47 days in CY22 to 66 days by March 2026 as studded-jewelry retail chains negotiated longer credit terms. Encouragingly, Q2 FY27 delivered a ₹662M receivables release. That cash inflow shows management is tightening collections rather than buying growth with loose credit [4].

Promoter Blackstone's 76.55% shareholding is another key governance watchpoint [14]. Under SEBI's Securities Contracts (Regulation) Rules (Rule 19A), newly listed firms must reach at least 25% public float (maximum 75% promoter stake) within three years of listing. That puts IGIL's compliance deadline at December 2027 [26]. A 1.55%–10% secondary block sale creates near-term supply overhang, but it will also expand free-float liquidity and institutional index eligibility.

book_paragraphs: Quarterly profit numbers tell you what happened last season; operational gauges tell you what is happening on the factory floor right now. For IGIL, six operational indicators capture the entire business engine. First is total reports issued, which hit 16.45 million during the 15-month FY26 transition period and 4.35 million in Q2 FY27 alone, up 26% YoY. Second is lab-grown diamond volume growth, where LGD jewelry surged 47% and loose LGD rose 37% in Q2 FY27. Third is implied realization per report—dividing ₹387.5 Cr of Q2 FY27 certification revenue by 4.35 million reports yields roughly ₹891 per report, showing that larger carat submissions are more than offsetting wholesale LGD price declines.

Fourth is physical network expansion, now standing at 36 laboratories and 21 gemology schools plus the newly acquired AGL hub in New York. Fifth is operating EBITDA margin, which climbed 340 basis points YoY to 61.4% in Q2 FY27 as fixed lab overhead amortized over higher volume. Sixth is debtor days, which drifted from 47 days in 2022 to 66 days in March 2026 before easing in Q2 FY27 via a ₹662 million working-capital release.

book_subsections.title: CEO Walk-the-Talk Audit: Tehmasp Printer and Eashwar Iyer
paragraphs: A management team's credibility is measured by the gap between what it promises during an IPO roadshow and what shows up in audited filings two years later. MD & CEO Tehmasp Printer, who started IGI India in 1999, and CFO Eashwar Iyer promised in December 2024 to consolidate IGI Belgium and IGI Netherlands immediately, defend high-50s operating margins, and compound LGD certification volumes. They delivered on every count: both European acquisitions closed within days of listing, 15M FY26 margins reached 61%, and in October 2026 management raised full-year FY27 revenue growth guidance from 15% to 27%+ after Q2 sales jumped 31% YoY.

Because five operational gauges are firing cleanly while debtor days require ongoing vigilance, IGIL earns a PASS_WITH_WATCH on operational KPI health—strong execution backed by real cash, tempered by the need to keep B2B credit terms tight.

book_subsections.title: Six Leading KPIs Every Owner Must Track Quarterly
paragraphs: If you own a certification toll-booth, quarterly earnings are a lagging indicator; the real story lives in six operational gauges. First is total reports issued—which just hit 4.35 million in Q2 FY27, up 26% year-on-year. Second is the mix between loose lab-grown solitaires, studded jewelry, and natural diamonds, because studded jewelry carries stickier retail relationships. Third is implied revenue per report (ASP), which tells you instantly whether volume rebates are biting into pricing power.

Fourth is debtor days (DSO): when DSO crept from 47 days to 66 days during the 15-month fiscal transition, skeptics rightly asked if IGI was extending credit to sustain volume; the ₹662 million receivables release in Q2 FY27 was the exact operational proof needed to answer that concern. Fifth is lab and gemologist utilization across the 36 global labs, and sixth is integration progress on AGL in colored stones. Watch those six dials, and you will spot any inflection—good or bad—two quarters before it hits the headline P&L.

book_subsections.title: The Blackstone Overhang & Management Execution
paragraphs: Every great business has a non-operating variable you must track alongside the P&L. For IGIL, that variable is the shareholder register. Blackstone owns 76.55% of the equity following the December 2024 IPO, which puts the company slightly above SEBI's 75% promoter cap under Minimum Public Shareholding rules. Before December 2027, Blackstone must trim at least 1.55%—and as a private equity sponsor, will likely monetize larger blocks along the way.

In the short run, secondary block sales often cap a stock's upside or trigger a 5% to 8% air-pocket on announcement day. Over the medium term, however, expanding the free float improves daily liquidity and opens the door for larger domestic mutual fund and passive index inclusions. Judging by CEO Tehmasp Printer's execution—raising FY27 revenue growth guidance from 15% to 27%+ on the back of 31% Q2 growth—the underlying business is outgrowing any private-equity supply overhang.

book_subsections.title: Separating Cyclical Noise from Structural KPIs
paragraphs: In any given quarter, diamond export volumes fluctuate around US holiday restocking, Diwali wedding demand, and Hong Kong jewelry trade shows. If you react to a single slow month of rough imports into Surat, you will miss the multi-year structural trend. Instead, focus on whether IGI's total certified report count is growing faster than global diamond jewelry units—which tells you certification penetration is still rising.

In Q2 FY27, total reports rose 26% year-on-year to 4.35 million while revenue grew 31% to ₹398 crore. That positive spread between revenue growth (+31%) and volume growth (+26%) is the single cleanest operational proof that blended ASPs held firm—driven by higher-value studded jewelry and larger-carat LGD solitaires—rather than being eroded by volume discounting.

book_subsections.title: How Management Incentives Align With Long-Term Owners
paragraphs: When a private equity sponsor like Blackstone retains 76.55% ownership alongside a professional CEO like Tehmasp Printer, you want to verify that management isn't sacrificing long-term pricing power just to dress up near-term revenue for a secondary block sale. Look at the evidence from FY25 through Q2 FY27: operating margins remained anchored in the 57% to 61% band, maintenance capex stayed disciplined under 4% of sales, and the team passed up low-margin commodity volume in favor of higher-value studded jewelry and colored-stone expansion via AGL.

Even more telling was the Q2 FY27 receivables release of ₹662 million. Had management been stuffing the channel with loose credit to hit its raised 27%+ revenue guidance, debtor days would have kept climbing past 66. Instead, cash collections accelerated alongside volume, confirming that growth quality remains intact.

book_callouts.title: What This Means for an Owner
book_callouts.text: Volume (+26% YoY), mix (LGD jewelry +47% YoY), and margins (61.4% OPM) confirm that IGIL's core engine is accelerating, while management has beaten its own post-IPO timeline and FY27 growth outlook. Keep an eye on debtor days staying below 70.
